purpose: Freeze one outcome-blind, exact Binance Spot 1d Cohort-001 provenance canary so the #705 positive trusted-acquisition path can be implemented and falsified without opening historical outcomes or broadening provider authority. Until #711 repairs quote-unit semantics, this slice may unlock only provenance-bound price, not USD liquidity.

selection.decision_rule: Use the first frozen Cohort-001 Monday for which the previous 30 completed UTC daily observations and the latest completed decision-price bar are wholly contained in one already-complete prior Binance monthly 1d archive.
selection.subject_rationale: BTCUSDT is a provider-path canary only. It is chosen to minimize new acquisition surface because the repository already has narrowly scoped Binance direct-object acquisition mechanics for BTCUSDT. This selection grants no historical-universe, membership, label, control, precursor, model, candidate, or trading authority and cannot satisfy Cohort-001 coverage thresholds by itself.

trusted_acquisition_requirements.execution_boundary: PIT Trusted Remote Acquisition workflow on canonical main via workflow_dispatch
trusted_acquisition_requirements.c101h_reuse_reason: Current BINANCE_C101H_ARCHIVE/CHECKSUM authority is contract-bound to #529 development-period 1h BTC/ETH/SOL data and does not authorize this 1d Cohort-001 2x slice. Extend/reuse the trusted workflow boundary without laundering C101-H consumer authority.

checksum.required_semantics: exact SHA-256 plus exact archive filename

chronology.reason: The selected archive month ends before decision_at, so any post-decision row indicates subject/period/content corruption rather than a row that should be silently filtered.

decision_price.semantics: Close of the latest completed UTC Binance Spot 1d kline whose close_time is strictly before decision_at.

trailing_30d_median_quote_volume_usd.reason: For BTCUSDT, Binance kline quote-asset volume is denominated in USDT. Authentic provider bytes and exact archive/checksum provenance do not prove a USD-denominated value. No authenticated PIT USDT/USD conversion is frozen in this path.
trailing_30d_median_quote_volume_usd.unlock_condition: A separately reviewed versioned repair must either keep the feature explicitly in the frozen quote-asset unit or provide a genuine PIT USD conversion with exact source/version/timestamp/provenance. Do not silently reinterpret V1.
